title: A Shopkeeper the Spikes kill counts as the player's kill
description: A thief who stole a cape waits on a floor past a hole with spikes in it. The angry shopkeeper chasing him jumps onto a block and walks off it into the hole. The spikes kill him, yet the game counts him as the player's kill and marks the player a murderer.
